content: Rahul Jain called insurance agent Sunita Agarwal to verify the first premium debit date, which is scheduled for 05/10/2026. He also inquired about adding a flood-damage rider for an additional ₹2,000 per year, agreeing to email the basement's elevation details later today. Additionally, Sunita confirmed that the kitchen renovation water damage coverage is already active.

action_items: Rahul will email the basement's elevation details to Sunita today
Sunita will issue an endorsement and adjust the premium once the details are received
